name: Riddim dubstep (mid-2010s American minimal-bass dubstep)
lineage: Mid-2010s American dubstep subgenre characterized by stripped-back minimal production focused on repetitive percussion-and-bass riddim, mechanical synth-bass-line designs, and minimal melodic content. Infekt, PhaseOne, Eptic, Virtual Riot, and the broader Disciple, Bassrush, and Never Say Die Records rosters anchor the canonical sound.
